fields.summary_ko.0: Wells Fargo raised Walmart (WMT) target price from $120 to $135 and maintained an Overweight rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart is trading at 43x net income, significantly above the 5-year average of 30x.
fields.summary_ko.2: The average target price from 44 analysts is $131, with Walmart facing the challenge of simultaneously achieving sales growth through price cuts and improved profitability.
